neighbours.label: The 'fall' word family as a token: fall, falls, fallen, falling, fallback, fall- in fallacy; not synonyms such as drop or descend
fire: The memorial lists the names of the fallen from both wars.
Drivers should watch for falling branches after the storm.
The temperature falls quickly once the sun goes down.
His reasoning rests on a well-known fallacy.
The app has a fallback mode for slow connections.
Several trees had fallen across the road overnight.
Snow kept falling on the village until morning.
The river falls sharply as it leaves the plateau.
quiet: The memorial lists the names of the dead from both wars.
Drivers should watch for broken branches after the storm.
The temperature drops quickly once the sun goes down.
His reasoning rests on a well-known mistake.
The app has a backup mode for slow connections.
Several trees had toppled across the road overnight.
Snow kept coming down on the village until morning.
The river descends sharply as it leaves the plateau.

notes: Card: 'all' after F x5, ' falls' x4, ' fallen' x4, 'alling', ' Falling'. Probes: fallen 0.51, falling 0.54, falls 0.53, fallacy 0.59, fallback 0.43, 'fall semester' 0.25; drops 0.02, loose rocks 0.00.
